versions.changelog: v0.6.0: 新增方向选择机制，用户说再来一批时先选择方向（效率/健康/创意/学习/随机），根据方向生成对应分类点子，减少重复。跨领域提示词支持6种语言。
v0.5.0: 修复点子重复推荐问题，LLM补充永不重复，每3次至少1次非投资相关跨领域点子
v0.4.8: 修复多语言问题，兴趣标签翻译，英文输出全英文点子，LLM跨领域点子持久化收藏
v0.4.7: 修复跨领域示例固定问题，随机选择示例
v0.4.6: 跨领域点子LLM实时生成，自动检测用户语言

Amazing Idea Generator v0.4.5 introduces improved idea voting and personalization:

- Added a 5-celebrity Agent voting system (Elon Musk, Steve Jobs, Bill Gates, Jeff Bezos, Sam Altman) with ideas passing at 7+ points.
- Enhanced personalized recommendations: ideas are now randomly mixed to avoid fixed order.
- Updated description and documentation for new features and multi-language support.

- Introduced a new celebrity Agent voting system: Elon Musk, Steve Jobs, Bill Gates, Jeff Bezos, and Sam Altman now "review" ideas.  
- Ideas that receive a score of 7 or higher from agents are marked as approved.
- Added support for the Agent voting logic in a new module.
- All features and instructions remain fully multi-language (6 languages supported).
- Updated documentation to highlight the new Agent-based voting mechanism.

Amazing Idea Generator v0.5.0 introduces LLM-powered real-time idea generation.

- When the 300+ local idea database is exhausted, the skill now seamlessly calls the current AI model to generate fresh new ideas.
- No additional cost or configuration is required—LLM mode is fully automatic.
- Existing features retained: user profile personalization, multi-language support, memory for seen ideas, favorites, and quality ratings.
- Documentation and descriptions updated to reflect the new hybrid static+LLM mode.
v0.4.2: 用户画像个性化（读取USER.md+memory生成相关点子），开场白质检清单，15分类300点子，多语言支持(6种)
新增5个分类：金融理财、旅行出行、亲子育儿、宠物养护、绿色生活。总计15分类300条点子。
v0.3.2: Enhanced user guide - Added deep analysis instructions, trending keywords explanation, difficulty legend (Easy/Medium/Hard), and updated category count to 200+.
v0.3.1: Added 7-day cache for deep analysis results - reduces API calls and improves response time for repeated queries.

v0.3.0: Hybrid mode - Removed static deep content, added on-demand dynamic deep analysis via web search. Static basics + dynamic deep content with real-time tech stack, market analysis, and learning resources.

v0.2.0: Content deepening - Added deep analysis for each idea including tech stack, architecture, key code, target users, market size, monetization, dev time, cost, risks, and learning resources. First 5 tool ideas now have full deep content.
v0.1.1: DuckDuckGo web search for trending ideas with auto-fallback to local data. 200 ideas in 10 categories with multi-language support (zh/en/ja/ko/es/fr).
Added difficulty indicator (Easy/Medium/Hard) and rating display for each idea
Added DuckDuckGo search integration, documented skill dependencies, added personality output examples for all 6 languages
Expanded to 10 categories (100+ ideas), added Lifestyle/Social/Learning/Health categories, reverse-chronological version history
Fixed hardcoded paths for portability, added MIT license, multi-language support (6 languages)
